questions.question: Which of the following compounds will undergo Aldol condensation?

options.explanation: Benzaldehyde lacks alpha-hydrogens.
Formaldehyde lacks alpha-hydrogens.
Propanal (CH₃CH₂CHO) has alpha-hydrogens.
2,2-Dimethylpropanal lacks alpha-hydrogens.

questions.explanation: Aldol condensation requires the presence of at least one alpha-hydrogen atom on the carbon adjacent to the carbonyl group.

questions.question: The product formed after Aldol condensation of acetaldehyde followed by heating is an:

options.explanation: The product formed after Aldol condensation of acetaldehyde followed by heating is not an alcohol.

The product formed after Aldol condensation of acetaldehyde followed by heating is an alpha,beta-unsaturated carbonyl compound.

questions.question: When ethanal reacts with dilute NaOH and is then heated, the major organic product formed is:

options.explanation: Butan-1-ol is not the major organic product formed when ethanal reacts with dilute NaOH and is then heated.
But-2-enal (crotonaldehyde) is the major organic product formed when ethanal reacts with dilute NaOH and is then heated.
Butanoic acid is not the major organic product formed when ethanal reacts with dilute NaOH and is then heated.
3-Hydroxybutanal is not the major organic product formed when ethanal reacts with dilute NaOH and is then heated.

questions.explanation: Ethanlal (acetaldehyde) undergoes Aldol condensation in the presence of dilute NaOH to form 3-hydroxybutanal. Upon heating, 3-hydroxybutanal dehydrates to form an alpha,beta-unsaturated aldehyde, which is But-2-enal (crotonaldehyde).

questions.question: Formaldehyde reacts with concentrated KOH solution. What are the main organic products formed?

options.explanation: Methanol and Potassium formate are the main organic products formed when formaldehyde reacts with concentrated KOH solution.
Methanoic acid and Methanol are not the main organic products formed when formaldehyde reacts with concentrated KOH solution.
Methane and Potassium carbonate are not the main organic products formed when formaldehyde reacts with concentrated KOH solution.
Formic acid and Water are not the main organic products formed when formaldehyde reacts with concentrated KOH solution.

questions.explanation: Formaldehyde lacks alpha-hydrogens and thus undergoes the Cannizzaro reaction in the presence of concentrated alkali. It undergoes disproportionation, where one molecule is oxidized to a carboxylic acid salt (Potassium formate) and another is reduced to an alcohol (Methanol).

questions.question: When a mixture of formaldehyde and benzaldehyde is treated with concentrated NaOH, the products obtained are:

options.explanation: Benzyl alcohol and Sodium formate are the products obtained when a mixture of formaldehyde and benzaldehyde is treated with concentrated NaOH.
Methanol and Sodium benzoate are not the products obtained when a mixture of formaldehyde and benzaldehyde is treated with concentrated NaOH.
Benzyl alcohol and Methanol are not the products obtained when a mixture of formaldehyde and benzaldehyde is treated with concentrated NaOH.
Sodium formate and Sodium benzoate are not the products obtained when a mixture of formaldehyde and benzaldehyde is treated with concentrated NaOH.
